title: THE UNMASKING

anchors.RAIL: the brass stern rail the gang stands along
anchors.LAGOON: still dawn water on both sides, the train's wake trailing
anchors.VENICE SKYLINE: far ahead, domes and a campanile in silhouette, shapes only

cast.depth: deck-centre, revealed at his full height
cast.action: stands revealed at his full height in the middle of the collapsed greatcoat, black body fully visible above the heap, perfectly still, hose arms at his sides, round head unbowed — standing perfectly still and silent
lies collapsed where it stands revealed — the greatcoat heaped, the stilt frame snapped inside it, an empty costume
cast.gaze_target: the costume's empty interior of cloth

cast.action: holds the grey peaked cap HIGH in his raised right hand for all to see, his left arm hanging at his side, his own black mask still on his face — the masked man holding the fake's hat

cast.depth: in the foreground, a full step closer to the camera than anyone
cast.action: holds the real diamond up in both hands at shoulder height, raised like a trophy, lagoon dawn firing blue-white through the stone, her face turned up toward it with a small satisfied smile — the detective with the prize

cast.depth: deck-right, half a step behind Lucy's line
cast.action: stands slightly bent at the waist, presenting Cyndi with an enormous bare marrow bone, unwrapped: the bone is in Cyndi's mouth between her front paws, and Akane's left hand steadies it as she presents it — the green-dial Rolex on that wrist catching the dawn — her other hand resting at her hip, an expression of pure deadpan on her face

cast.depth: in front of Akane, up on her hind legs
cast.action: sits up tall in a begging pose, front paws holding the enormous bone, ears up, eyes fixed on it — the happiest person on the train

moment: The reveal at dawn, caught a breath after the capture — every gaze is on the cap, the culprit, the stone, or each other. The conductor applauds alone at the deck's engine-end edge, the only audience the gang needs.
environment: open deck boards; the brass stern rail; the train's wake creasing the still lagoon; the Venice, Italy skyline ahead in soft silhouette — St Mark's campanile, domes and moored gondolas on lagoon water, unmistakably Venice; deck lamps still burning warm; a dropped ticket lying face-down showing only blank paper.
lighting: rose-gold dawn key from dead ahead behind the skyline, rimming the group; warm deck lamps low fill; soft long shadows up the boards.
colour: full, rich, celebratory colour everywhere in the generation — rose dawn, gold lamps, blue lagoon.
negatives: the skyline, the ticket and the stone carry blank surfaces
a calm aftermath: everyone whole, free and unhurt, with clean costumes and undamaged props
Void stands upright, free and whole
Akane's hands stay busy in her lap or at her sides
the far shore is Venice, Italy: lagoon, domes, campanile and gondolas
Wyatt's hands are clean bare skin, his only tattoos the king and queen on his neck

omit_sentences: Around Void the world's colour drains toward grey within a radius of about one of its own heights, fully desaturated at its silhouette and fading back to full colour at the edge of the radius.
